title: Space Builder
tagline: Build in 3-D space — solids, points, vectors (dev preview V0)

input.placeholder: Type a given, e.g.: cube ABCD

hint.orbit: Drag the figure to orbit · scroll to zoom

facts.empty: No givens yet — type one or click an example
facts.claimVerified: The claim was verified against the figure

status.inactive: Inactive — a given it depends on is off

err.notUnderstood: I couldn't understand that given (this version: solids, points on segments, vector naming, and claims to verify)
err.alreadyDefined: '{{id}}' is already defined in the figure
err.unknownVector: Vector '{{id}}' is not declared — name it first (denote AB = u)
err.badSolid: The number of vertices doesn't fit the requested solid
err.badName: A vector name is a single lowercase letter (e.g. u)
err.needBasis: This point needs three declared vectors (a basis) — e.g.: denote AB = u, AD = v, AA' = w
err.noSolution: No position of '{{id}}' satisfies the condition
err.notOnSegment: '{{id}}' falls outside the segment — the condition doesn't hold on the segment itself
err.claimRefuted: The claim doesn't hold in the figure — check the computation

examples.ex3: M is the midpoint of BB'
examples.ex4: K on AA' such that AK = 2KA'
examples.ex5: denote AB = u, AD = v, AA' = w
examples.ex6: CA' is perpendicular to plane BC'D
